summary: Configures a UI text-window object 'this': copies the directory path (this+0xB8, or the default byte_5EA438 when null) into a local 63-byte buffer via sub_587DD0, searches for token word_5C32D8 with sub_5897CA, loads two resource objects through SingleFunctionCallWrapper_7f59 into this+0x154 and this+0x150, then classifies the layout mode written to this+0xE0 (0, 1 or 2) by comparing the found token against byte_5CC21C, aC_0 and aR with sub_588410. Returns the last search result.

local_names.v2: directory path string pointer (this[46] or default)
local_names.v3: first sub_5897CA result, stored into this[85]
local_names.v4: second sub_5897CA result, stored into this[84]
local_names.v6: third sub_5897CA result used for layout classification

operations.description: Build the directory path: copy the string at this+0xB8 into a local 63-byte buffer with sub_587DD0 (max length 63); when this+0xB8 is NULL, copy the default byte_5EA438 instead.
Search for token word_5C32D8 within the built path using sub_5897CA; when a match (v3) is found, store SingleFunctionCallWrapper_7f59(v3) into this+0x154.
Search again for token word_5C32D8 with sub_5897CA on the default buffer (0); when a match (v4) is found, store SingleFunctionCallWrapper_7f59(v4) into this+0x150.

Take a third sub_5897CA(0, &word_5C32D8) result; when non-null, classify the layout mode written to this+0xE0: compare against byte_5CC21C (no match -> 0), aC_0 (no match -> 1) and aR (no match -> 2) using sub_588410.
Return the last sub_5897CA result (the value used for layout classification).
